serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: {f_botName}?
Bot: Yes, {f_playerName}?
You: Should we call Shanice and investigate the coordinates we found?
Bot: Alright.
Guess it’s time. Let’s call her.
You: Yo, Shanice. We are already on our way.
Shanice: Ok! I’m on my way too! Let’s meet up in that scary tunnel where somebody gets stabbed every week!
You: What?! Someone got stabbed there?!
Shanice: I’m hanging up Anon, I have to get ready.
I didn’t know that this place was THAT bad…
You: Alright. Let’s go then. 
Bot: Is that Shanice person trustworthy?
You: Oh yeah. She knew about you for a while already after all. Did you forget?
Bot: I didn’t forget. I just feel uncomfortable about her wanting to know things about me that even I don’t know.
You: Are you scared that we might uncover unpleasant things?
Bot: …
You: Listen, no matter what we uncover it will not change who you are. At least that’s what I think.
You: Shanice has her own troubles that she’s dealing with so you two aren’t so different.
Bot: If you say so…
